title: Headless Hard Luck Blues (VES34Vault), the survivors saved: the readings (10-25), Vault 34's survivors saved at the master override (40, 60), Morgan Blake killed (70, 80)

actions.text: Path: as hard-luck-blues to the reactor terminal (stage 25); the master override's other entry, the vault's survivors saved (item 2: stage 40, whose script sets 60); then Morgan Blake killed by the player (kill stands in for the fight: V34MorganBlakeScript's OnDeath sets 70 while 50 or 60 is not done; 70's script sets 80). Travel is move_player.
Stand-in for the trip to the sharecropper farms.

The East Pump Station terminal's repair entry needs Science 50 (EastPumpStationTermMsg, '[Science of 50 or greater required...', its button hidden by its conditions) [observed: pilot rerun log]. Stand-in for a player who has the skill: Science 50.
Stand-in for the trip to the East Pump Station.
Stand-in for the trip through Vault 34's flooded, irradiated halls to the reactor.

Vault 34's reactor lies behind V34OverseerDoor (0x0012CC9B, locked at level 255, no key); only TERM V34SecurityNorthTerminalSystem (0x0013253D) item 0 unlocks it ('0x0012CC9B.unlock') [observed: decompiled, decode]. Stand-in for the walk to that terminal and its entry (no placed reference of the terminal is found by its base): the door is unlocked as the entry leaves it.
